title: Design test-connection API endpoint specification
description: Design the backend API endpoint specification for testing PostgreSQL connection credentials, including request/response format and error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Request format includes host, port, database, user, password
Response format includes success/failure and error message
Error handling for invalid credentials is defined

evidence: Created docs/api/test-connection.md specifying the POST /api/v1/connections/test endpoint: request format (host, port, database, user, password), response format (success/failure + error message), status codes (200/400/401/502/503/504/500), and error handling for invalid credentials (401 with descriptive message, password never logged/returned).

All four acceptance criteria covered: (1) endpoint documented, (2) request includes host/port/database/user/password, (3) response includes success/failure and error message, (4) invalid-credential error handling defined (§4.1).
